svg.title: The movement pipeline, from route file to phone
svg.desc: A route JSON is snapped to real roads by Valhalla, gets road data (speed limits, lights, junctions), is driven by a driver model (red lights, stop signs, turns, GPS jitter), checked by a validator that refuses impossible speed or braking, turned into timed fixes and played on the phone through the CoreDevice simulation at real speed. A seed makes the drive identical every time.
